scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/migrate-test.mjs && npm run test:integration -w apps/api
scripts.setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
